title: Social Security number and card - basics
facts: A Social Security number is a unique identifier issued by the Social Security Administration for authorized purposes including reporting wages.
The physical Social Security card is not intended to be carried routinely when it is not needed; SSA advises keeping it in a safe place.
A Social Security number generally remains the same for life, even when a replacement card is issued.
Different card legends can reflect work-authorization restrictions for some noncitizens.
